candidates.description: This vector activates for common syllables, short words, and linguistic roots across multiple languages, including Thai and English.
This vector activates on the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) and words or syllables containing it.
These tokens represent common Thai language subword units, suffixes, and character combinations frequently found in text processing tokenizers.
This vector represents the Thai consonant 'ส' (so sua) and its various combinations with Thai vowel markers, tone marks, and surrounding contextual tokens.
This feature vector represents common Thai syllable and character combinations frequently appearing as sub-word tokens.
This feature vector activates on terms, morphemes, and translations related to the academic study of psychology, psychoanalysis, and scientific disciplines.
This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords starting with the letters "Ne" or "Na" across multiple languages and writing systems.
This feature vector represents common grammatical conjunctions, prepositions, and structural punctuation across multiple languages.
This feature vector is activated by tokens from diverse, non-English scripts and multilingual characters.
This vector represents academic, psychological, and demographic terminology across multiple languages.
